name: Great Fairy
description: A fairy that restores health or upgrades the player's items.

1.name: Item Upgrade
1.description: Upgrades the player's item and sets the corresponding activation variable.

2.name: Item Upgrade (Unused / Bug)
2.description: Attempts to upgrade the item at index 0, regardless of the player's current item. The upgrade is bugged, and the fairy disappears afterward. Not used in normal gameplay.

fields.name: Item Upgrade Target (Internal)
fields.description: Selects the item upgraded to level 2 by the Great Fairy.

fields.name: Player Number (Internal)
fields.description: Selects the player associated with the Item Upgrade.

fields.name: Player 1 Activation Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable checked before upgrading item and set afterward. If 0, an upgrade items unlimited times.
